scope: Phase 11 explicit host-only provider, secret and credit development scenarios; no live calls or spend

checks.name: Provider preview remains empty and disconnected until explicitly connected
Connect registers only deterministic development agents and no provider execution
Browser sees configuration presence and local integer credit budgets only
Manager creates canonical request plan task and workstation intent
Provider execution waits for real scene arrival
Existing navigation seated work and worker-only headband remain intact
Distinct Manager remains headband-free
Actual ToolExecutor invokes broker and settles reported fixture usage
Request reservation settlement ledger and activity share canonical runtime events
Provider success does not complete verify or automatically persist an output
Host secrets and raw prompt are absent from request record and ledger
Credit UI displays genuine estimates charges and configured remaining budget
Explicit artifact capture retains tool identity immutable hash and unverified status
Explicit memory capture preserves unverified tool provenance
Worker exact-ID mesh selection and camera focus still work
Manager exact-ID mesh selection retains distinct headband-free presentation
Explicit completion safely removes headband without claiming QA verification
denied is rejected before charge and puts the canonical task into attention
budget is rejected before charge and puts the canonical task into attention
unavailable is rejected before charge and puts the canonical task into attention
all-unavailable is rejected before charge and puts the canonical task into attention
missing-credential is rejected before charge and puts the canonical task into attention
unknown-provider is rejected before charge and puts the canonical task into attention
Explicit fallback uses an approved alternate with preserved primary/reason
Unknown billing retains conservative reservation instead of pretending failure is free
Unsafe response is rejected while actual incurred usage remains accounted
Unsafe provider data never reaches snapshots UI memory artifacts events or browser storage
Transport rejects injected provider input and authority
Foreign-origin invocation remains blocked
Direct raw and filesystem host source requests are denied without leaking configured values
Idle provider preview introduces no polling or repeated provider requests
Disconnect retains history while presenting inactive runtime
Reconnect restores the same authoritative session without repeating calls
Open-top overview and camera reset remain usable
Canonical GLB resources remain shared across scenario transitions
No unexpected console errors failed requests or hot reloads
Acceptance source remained unchanged during browser validation

limitations: Deterministic host adapters only; no external provider or financial transaction.
Unknown charges remain reserved pending authoritative host reconciliation.
Credential detection is pattern-based plus exact configured value checks; no universal secret detection or independent proof of verification.
Software Chromium rendering is not an RTX hardware benchmark.
